notes: A single handwritten continuation and closing of a French letter signed P. Deligne. The argument represents a global class by local extensions over an affine cover, discusses transition isomorphisms and an obstruction differential, and transfers the construction to the analytic case using GAGA. One live remark extends the discussion to algebraic spaces, rigid analytic spaces and formal schemes; only the following remark heading is cancelled, and all readable cancelled text is retained. There is no title, date or manuscript page number on this sheet. The pencilled archive number is 75; our scan is 76. No explicit author doubt marker is visible. The source index j, donné, remark number 1 and itou are settled; the recurring transition alphabet, target index, possible d-to-t overwrite, cancelled heading suffix and origin/function of the detached marks remain reader uncertainties. H is descriptive only and is unavailable for word-by-word collation. Whole-page layout was viewed once, then half a and half b once in order. Half b starts at whole-image y=920. The nine retained crops were each delivered and actually viewed once; none was recropped or revisited.
math_reading_decisions: Confirmed from the halves: the cover is U_i of X_0; each i is lowered and short, and the zero is a small lowered oval. The inserted extension notation has a raised prime and a lower dotted i. The restrictions are upright bars, not slashes.

First cohomology H is ordinary, with a raised zero and the parenthesized alg still higher to the right: H^{0^{(\mathrm{alg})}}. The script initial in \mathscr{E}xt^1 has rounded lobes; xt is on the baseline and 1 is raised.
K has one principal stem and two right arms, without an independent doubled stem; the ideal letter has a looped/curved script N form. Preserved K and \mathscr{N} in each separate formula occurrence.

The transition form remains \unsure{\eta|n|\gamma} at the first occurrence only; repeated forms are rendered \eta. The lowered pairs ij, jk and ik in the cocycle line have their distinct short i, descending j and branched k strokes.

The transition arrow has one horizontal shaft and a right-pointing arrowhead, with one short wave above. Its source subscript is j. The target suffix remains \unsure{i|j|k}; no earlier overwritten suffix was independently recoverable.

The obstruction is written d_2\eta, not d_2e. Each 2 beside d is low. In the final display the source H exponent is 0 and the target exponent is 2; Ext has exponent 1. The target Hom initial is a looped script H, unlike the ordinary cohomology H.

Both displayed cohomology arguments close twice, once after (K,\mathscr{N}) and again after the enclosing X_0 argument. No sign, index, correction or terminal mathematical punctuation was supplied from expected mathematics.

The opening class e belongs to the source H^0 Ext group displayed for d_2, while the obstruction sentence uses the eta-type sign after d_2. This is a possible notation tension, not a verified error; d_2 eta is preserved. No proof of the obstruction theorem or GAGA claim was attempted.
